subject: Re: MAP + Eval plan — MSA/DPA sequencing for HelioHealth
messages:
From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@heliohealth.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + Eval plan — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Hi David / Laura,

Thanks for the call today. To keep our procurement team moving, can you share a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation gates, evidence handoff for SOC2/Security questionnaire, and the sequencing you expect for MSA -> DPA -> Order Form? Procurement needs to see a realistic target date for signature and when we can expect to have the production keys/regions pinned.

A few constraints from our side:
- Procurement needs a DocuSign-ready contract by 25 Aug to hit our internal approval cycle the week after.
- We will need DPA redlines accepted or tracked separately before signature; our legal team will flag any scope changes to data flows.
- PO issuance typically takes 3 business days after DocuSign executed by our finance approver.

Can you draft a short timeline (1 page) and indicate any prerequisites we should surface to legal/procurement now?

Appreciate it — Emma
Emma Turner
Head of Procurement, HelioHealth
emma.turner@heliohealth.com
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@heliohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval plan — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Emma — thanks for the clear constraints. Attached is a compact MAP and an evaluation cadence I put together for the team (MAP-HelioHealth-v2.xlsx). High level summary below and a proposed lockstep schedule so procurement can plan:

Summary and sequencing (short):
1) Week 0 (today–25 Aug): Legal reviews — Laura will propose DPA redlines and flag any data-flow items. We prepare DocuSign-ready MSA + Order Form (with placeholders) by 25 Aug.
2) Week 1 (25–29 Aug): DocuSign circulation + sign by both execs. Procurement issues PO ~3 business days after signature.
3) Week 2 (1–5 Sep): Dedicated provisioning window — pin region and production keys; smoke test.
4) Week 3 (8–12 Sep): Acceptance evaluation run (3-day traffic test + quality checks).

Key prerequisites for HelioHealth legal/procurement to confirm now:
- Confirmation of data residency region (us-east-1 or us-west-2).
- Any mandatory contractual clauses (escrow, audit window) beyond our standard DPA.
- Point person for SOC2 evidence intake (we can deliver a read-only link).

Attachments included (stubs):
- MAP-HelioHealth-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB) — one-page timeline + task owner column.
- DocuSign-proforma-link.txt — placeholder we will replace with live link once redlines are tracked.

Laura/Karthik/Marissa — can you confirm availability for an internal sync tomorrow morning to align on redlines and the final DocuSign bundle?

Thanks — david
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Emma Turner <emma.turner@heliohealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval plan — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Emma/David — reviewed the base DPA and sketched a focused redline set. Two items to call out that will affect sequencing:

1) Data subject scope: We need HelioHealth to confirm whether any PHI will be stored/processed. If yes, we must add the PHI-specific appendix which adds one extra legal review cycle (3–4 business days).
2) Subprocessor list: HelioHealth asked for an explicit subprocessor inventory — we can provide the list but legal prefers subprocessor addendum sign-off ahead of full execution.

I attached the redlines as a stub (DPA-Redlines-Helio_v1.docx). If Helio can confirm PHI=no and accept the standard subprocessor terms, we can keep to the 25 Aug DocuSign target. If PHI=yes, recommend we split execution: sign MSA + Order Form on 25 Aug with a tracked DPA addendum to follow (we will flag any operational constraints in the MAP).

Internal note for sequencing: David — if we go split-execution approach, we should include an explicit fallback clause for provisioning to start on signature of MSA+OrderForm and conditional on DPA addendum being mutually agreed within 30 days. I'll draft language.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Emma Turner <emma.turner@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval plan — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Adding operational sequencing detail from infra/enablement perspective (mapping to David's MAP):

- Provisioning window: Our earliest non-breaking provisioning slot is 1 Sep. We can reserve capacity if DocuSign completes by 29 Aug EOD.
- Keys/regions: Assuming us-east-1 by default. If you need a different region we need confirmation by 25 Aug to avoid rework in provisioning.
- Canary plan: Recommend a 48–72 hour low-traffic canary with rollback gates (health checks + latency SLA checks) before ramping to acceptance run. That can be scheduled for 1–3 Sep.
- Evidence handoff: SOC2 artifact package will be shared via a secured folder; please provide the name and email of the Helio evidence intake lead.

Operational blockers to call out: any DPA-required audit windows or long-term log retention beyond 12 months will require a configuration review and may push the production date by ~1 week.

I can join the procurement call on 21 Aug to walk through these milestones and pin exact dates.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@heliohealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval plan — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Thanks all — this is helpful. Quick answers from procurement/legal:
- PHI: No PHI in scope — patient identifiers are tokenized upstream; we can confirm in writing by EOD.
- Region: us-east-1 is fine.
- Evidence intake: Rafael Ortega (rafael.ortega@heliohealth.com) will own SOC2 artifacts.
- PO timeline: procurement expects to sign and issue PO the week of 1 Sep if DocuSign is live by 29 Aug.

Please proceed with DocuSign-ready MSA + Order Form on 25 Aug. Can you confirm who will upload the final bundle and whether we can get a pre-sent proforma link for internal visibility?

Emma
Emma Turner
Head of Procurement, HelioHealth
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@heliohealth.com>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP + Eval plan — sequencing MSA/DPA/order form

Emma — great, thanks for the confirmations. Next steps and commitments (finalized):

- We will upload the finalized MSA + Order Form bundle to DocuSign on Mon 25 Aug (target 09:00 PT). Link placeholder: DocuSign-proforma-link.txt (we will replace with live link when available).
- Laura will submit tracked DPA redlines by 25 Aug. Since PHI is out of scope, we will proceed with standard DPA and track the subprocessor addendum in parallel.
- Karthik will reserve the provisioning window 1–3 Sep for canary + acceptance run.
- Rafael Ortega will receive SOC2 artifacts via secure folder by 25 Aug — please confirm acceptance once you receive it.

Milestone commitments:
- 25 Aug: DocuSign bundle uploaded and legal sign-off ready.
- 27–29 Aug: DocuSign circulation and signatures (target).
- 1 Sep: Provisioning begins; canary run 1–3 Sep.
- 4–8 Sep: Acceptance run and PO issuance if all gates pass.

If procurement can confirm the finance approver's availability for signature the week of 27 Aug, we should be on track to start provisioning 1 Sep.

I'll follow up with the DocuSign link as soon as it's live. Thanks everyone — short sync tomorrow 9:30 AM PT to confirm final bundle?

Best,
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
